items: Liquids gases ki tarah phailte (diffuse hote) hain, magar liquids mein diffusion ki raftar kahin kam hai.
Nisbatan mazboot intermolecular forces ki wajah se liquid molecules ke darmiyan bohat kam jagah hai.
Liquids gases se 10^5 guna kam dabne wale hain magar solids se taqreeban 10 guna zyada.
Liquid ke molecules musalsal be-tarteeb harkat mein hain, magar gases se sust. Milne wale (miscible) liquids ka diffusion is azad harkat ka saboot hai, aur liquids isi ki wajah se behte hain.
Garam karne par liquids phailte hain, magar yeh phailao gases ke muqable mein na-hone ke barabar hai.

Kinetic molecular theory se liquid ke molecules musalsal harkat mein hain aur is liye har darja hararat par kinetic energy rakhte hain; yeh darja hararat ke saath barhti ya ghatti hai. Liquid kinetic energy ghatne (thanda karne) par solid banta hai aur barhne (garam karne) par bukharat (vapour).

blocks.prompt: Do milne wale liquids ehtiyat se ek beaker mein dale aur chhor diye jate hain; kuch der baad woh bina hilaye yaksan mil jate hain. Yeh liquids ki kaun si khasoosiyat dikhata hai, aur yeh gases ke muqable mein sust kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh diffusion dikhata hai, jo liquid molecules ki musalsal be-tarteeb harkat se aata hai. Yeh gases se sust hai kyunke liquid molecules qareeb qareeb hain, un ke darmiyan kam jagah hai aur woh mazboot intermolecular forces se bandhe hue sust chalte hain.

items: Liquids (sust) diffuse karte hain, molecules ke darmiyan kam jagah, gases se 10^5 guna kam aur solids se 10 guna zyada dabne wale, be-tarteeb harkat se behte hain, thora phailte hain, aur kinetic energy ghatne (solid) ya barhne (vapour) par halat badalte hain.
